name: Davis Museum
notes: Rafael Moneo's Davis Museum at Wellesley College (1993): a closed box of warm red brick, four tall storeys with precast bands at the floors, one large window and the entrance slot on the plaza side, its top-floor galleries lit by metal-clad lanterns of different sizes set in a pinwheel on the roof, each with a band of clerestory glass; the bridge east to Paul Rudolph's Jewett Arts Center, and Moneo's low brick Collins Cinema across the plaza. From Wellesley's building page, Moneo's office and Arquitectura Viva; guessed: dimensions (about 36 x 44 m, 21 m high), the lanterns' exact arrangement and cladding (the roof is copper), the cinema's roof. No photographs were available.
